name: transition-crossfade
title: Crossfade / Dissolve
description: Cảnh mới hiện dần đè lên cảnh cũ trong khoảng 12 khung hình, cảnh cũ giữ nguyên bên dưới cho tới hết.

moworks.author: takayu

options.ease: none, or sine.inOut as the site's demo

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-dissolve, written here): Incoming scene opacity 0 -> 1 over the outgoing one in 500 ms (atlas: ~12 frames at 24 fps), linear (the demo eases it in-out); the outgoing scene stays at 1 underneath (no dip to the film background) and hides at the end. HF showcase-dissolve ships Crossfade / Color Dip / Blur Crossfade / Focus Pull (Apache-2.0). Params: duration (0.5 s) · ease (none / sine.inOut).
